data_quality_assurance: Data cleaning and consistency checks were applied to the original census tables to identify and correct format inconsistencies and duplicates. Final geospatial products were validated by cross-checking values with official sources and performing visual inspections. All scripts used in the processing pipeline are version-controlled in GitHub to ensure reproducibility.
dataset.description: Spatially explicit maps of the Spanish agrarian census from 1982-1989-1999-2009, and 2020. This research is part of the project INFORICAM (PID2020-119402RB-I00), funded by the Agencia Estatal de Investigación MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and by the European Union.

format: The data are provided in standard, open and interoperable formats to ensure long-term preservation and usability. Geospatial layers are shared as ESRI Shapefiles (.shp, .shx, .dbf, .prj).  Attribute tables and metadata are available as Excel (.xlsx) and PDF (.pdf) documents. All formats comply with widely accepted standards for geographic and statistical data.

distribution.available_until: The dataset will be made accessible immediately upon project completion. No embargo period will be applied.

security_and_privacy.description: The dataset contains only aggregated and anonymised agricultural census data, with no sensitive or personal information. Therefore, no specific security measures are required.
